title: Four more ways to build with Pollinations
summary:
Four community projects joined the directory while privacy defaults and the way pollinations.ai appears in shared links got attention.

The project listings gained a real-time model comparison tool, a Telegram word game that turns players’ words into images, Zelos AI’s prompt-enhanced image generator, and image1gen’s web interface for image generation. The invitation to submit a project also got shorter and more direct.

A merged change treats requests to `/openai` paths as private even when `private` is omitted or set to false. Other paths keep their existing behavior.

The site’s sharing metadata gained a social-share banner, image dimensions, and a large Twitter card. The default description and organization details for search engines were refreshed too.
